description: This file is a shell script used in Git testing, specifically testing case-insensitive file system behavior during merge operations. It defines test cases and setup procedures for verifying the correct handling of case-changing renames in Git.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a specific prerequisite (here, case-insensitive file system support).

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines and runs a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
